title: Teleology-Driven Affective Computing: A Causal Framework for Sustained Well-Being
reasoning: The paper uses philosophical and ethical frameworks (such as teleology, eudaimonia, and hedonism) to establish a theoretical foundation for agent well-being and reward function design. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as the primary subject of its research; rather, it uses these concepts to propose a new computational framework.
